name: fair-2x2
purpose: Fair language comparison in one run with the same binaries: library parsers (C# System.Text.Json vs C++ simdjson) and specialized parsers (C# FastJson vs its line-by-line C++ port). C++ is compiled for the host CPU (/arch:AVX512), as the .NET JIT does. Same corpora, seeds, durations and rules as campaign.json; see docs/benchmarks/parser-challenge.md.
